title: Classification signal_stream availability and artifact_signal composition
method: Raw-data descriptive analysis; no model scores, predictions, Test data, or Test labels.

source.path_role: official Classification Train resolved with src.utils.paths.task_files

definitions.availability: Round2 stream_missing_mask: null, blank, or whitespace-only stream is missing
definitions.uncertainty_interval: Wilson 95%; descriptive per-group intervals, not an adjusted contrast CI
definitions.minimum_exact_cycle_support: minimal 20 baris pada masing-masing status availability
definitions.standardization: within each supported cycle compute missing-present prevalence; weight each cycle by its share of all rows in the pooled supported-cycle population

text_load_sensitivity.binning_rule: Global qcut quantiles of text_load on all official Train rows. Binning uses neither artifact_signal nor availability.

cycle_only.compared_denominator_definition: The standardized rates use only supported-cell rows; report both group-specific denominator/coverage and pooled supported-cell rows above.
cycle_only.weight_definition: Within a supported cell, weight=(n_present+n_missing)/total rows in supported cells; identical weights apply to both cell-specific rates.

text_load_sensitivity.interpretation: Different standardized contrasts can reflect composition and cell-support changes. They are descriptive sensitivity checks, not causal adjustment or proof that text_load confounds availability; supported-row and group-specific coverage must accompany the contrast.

interpretation_limits: Associations are descriptive and do not show that missingness causes either label.
Cycle standardization controls only cycle composition; it does not control text_load or the record-generation process.
Wilson intervals describe each raw prevalence separately; no adjusted contrast interval or hypothesis test is claimed.
Cycle and period results use development Train repeatedly examined elsewhere; they are sensitivity descriptions, not independent confirmation.
Missing versus present may represent different information-collection processes; missingness is not a text-quality measure.
